I work with cloud infrastructure and enterprise data services, with
hands-on experience provisioning and managing Microsoft Azure resources
and an ongoing focus on exploring Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

My interests span resource provisioning, deployment architectures, and
integrating enterprise technologies with cloud platforms.

My practical Azure responsibilities include resource administration,
data-platform support, and troubleshooting issues that affect reliable
data processing.

| Microsoft Azure | Resource provisioning, configuration, and operational support |
| Azure Resource Groups | Organization and administration of related cloud resources |
| Azure Databricks (ADB) | Provisioning and resource management |
| Azure Data Factory (ADF) | Resource administration, pipeline monitoring, and troubleshooting |
| Integration Runtime (IR) | Investigation and resolution of operational issues |
| Azure Key Vault | Provisioning and administration with a security focus |

## Microsoft Azure: Resource Provisioning and Management

I provisioned and managed Azure resources supporting enterprise
data-platform environments.

The work covered Azure Resource Groups, Azure Databricks, Azure Data
Factory, and Azure Key Vault, with attention to security, scalability,
and cost optimization.

### Resource Groups

Managed Azure Resource Groups as part of organizing and administering
cloud resources supporting enterprise workloads.

This work formed part of the broader provisioning and maintenance
activities required to keep the cloud environment aligned with
operational needs.

### Azure Databricks

Provisioned and managed Azure Databricks resources within enterprise
data environments.

My responsibilities focused on resource administration and supporting
the infrastructure requirements of the platform.

### Azure Data Factory

Provisioned and administered Azure Data Factory resources and supported
the ongoing operation of data-processing pipelines.

This included monitoring pipeline execution, investigating failures,
and resolving issues affecting operational continuity.

### Azure Key Vault

Provisioned and managed Azure Key Vault resources as part of the
environment's security-focused cloud administration.

## Data Pipeline Monitoring and Troubleshooting

A significant part of my Azure work involved investigating issues that
interrupted data processing or prevented workloads from running as
expected.

### ADF Pipeline Failures

- Monitored pipeline execution and identified failed runs.
- Investigated failures affecting data-processing workflows.
- Applied corrective actions to restore pipeline operations.
- Supported reliable processing and operational continuity.

### Integration Runtime Issues

Investigated and resolved Integration Runtime issues affecting Azure
Data Factory operations.

The focus was on identifying the cause of processing interruptions
and restoring the affected workflows.

### Azure Quota Constraints

Investigated and addressed Azure quota constraints affecting resource
provisioning or workload execution.

This work supported capacity requirements and helped resolve
resource-related barriers to ongoing operations.

## Security, Scalability, and Cost Awareness

My approach to cloud administration considers operational requirements
alongside security, growth, and resource consumption.

### Security

Maintained a security-focused approach when provisioning and managing
Azure services, including Key Vault.

### Scalability

Considered workload requirements and resource constraints when
supporting cloud environments, including issues involving service
quotas and available capacity.

### Cost Optimization

Included cost considerations in resource-management activities,
with a focus on aligning cloud resources with operational needs.

These were guiding priorities in my administration work. No specific
cost-saving percentage or platform-wide availability improvement is
claimed here.

## Google Cloud Platform: Ongoing Exploration

Alongside my Azure experience, I am exploring Google Cloud Platform
to broaden my understanding of cloud infrastructure and enterprise
deployment options.

My areas of interest include:

- Cloud infrastructure and resource provisioning.
- Deployment architectures.
- Integrating enterprise technologies with cloud services.
- Security, scalability, and operational management.
- Comparing approaches across Azure and GCP.

My detailed delivery experience on this page relates to Azure. The GCP
section reflects ongoing exploration rather than a claim of equivalent
production administration experience.
